# Checkbox API

Toggle one optional value or represent a partially selected parent.

This page is lookup reference for the exact public contract. Start from the usage examples when you are composing or styling the component.

[Back to Checkbox usage and examples](/components/checkbox)

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Space</kbd> | Toggle the current value. |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move through the normal document focus order. |
